en: Welcome to the Trainer House's hall! One battle a day, against the Trainer of the day.
Today it's Cal. He's waiting at the far end of the hall. Speak to him when you're ready.
That's today's battle fought. Come back tomorrow, and there'll be another!
I'm Cal, today's Trainer of the house. Want to battle me?
Then let's make it a good one!
What a battle! You're as strong as they say. Come back tomorrow for another.
That was close! Come back tomorrow and try me again.
Whenever you like. I'm here all day.
One battle a day, those are the house rules. See you tomorrow!
